messages:
Sam (CSM): Day 0 shadow traffic check for Vega. Plan: mirror 0->10% of live prod traffic into their reserved pool over 10m, hold ~1h, then ramp down. Goal: validate autoscaler, KV/prefix cache priming, and 95p latency <120ms. Need SE + oncall present. Starting target window 15:05 UTC.
Priya (SE): Copy. I'll create the replay job and seed KV cache. Model/route to test?
Jordan (Vega PM): We'll point at /v1/generate using redwood/gpt-small-8k. Client side can sustain 250rps peak; mirror should be 10% of that. Target metrics: 95th <120ms, error rate <0.5%.
Miguel (Eng-Oncall): I'll be on standby. Alerts: gpu_util>85% or queue_len>100. Autoscaler adjusted to min 12 -> max 40 replicas for the reserved pool during the run.
capacity-bot: Reserved pool composition: 4xA100 nodes. Estimated headroom at 10% mirror: ~3.2x baseline. No quota hit expected.
Sam (CSM): Priya — drop the traffic-mirror command + priming snippet here and link to the dashboard.
Priya (SE): Commands:

```
# create mirror
traffic-mirror create --from prod --to vega-reserved --pct 10 --ramp 10m --duration 1h30m --route "/v1/generate"
# priming
python tools/prime_kv.py --pool vega-reserved --model redwood/gpt-small-8k --prompts tests/vega_prompts.json
```

Dash: https://console.redwood/boards/vega-shadow-1687654321 (internal)
Miguel (Eng-Oncall): Canary/fallback policy in place: on 5xx spike or queue_len>80 we flip traffic back to hosted API. I also added a short-circuit: if avg token latency >200ms for 2m -> runbook step.
Jordan (Vega PM): We plan to start at 15:05 UTC from eu-west1. We'll capture client logs + sample prompts. Priya, can you enable request-id tagging so we can reconcile responses?
Priya (SE): Yes — mirror will include x-vega-request-id header. Will also push a snapshot of 95/99/median latency and error counts to the dashboard after run.
Sam (CSM): Post-run checklist: 95p latency, error rate, tokens/sec, autoscale transitions count, any model output drift on sample prompts. Capture screenshots + raw logs.
Jordan (Vega PM): Acknowledged. We'll also run our prompt-regression tests and paste diffs here.
Miguel (Eng-Oncall): Standing by. Reaction :thumbsup:
Sam (CSM): Thanks all — reconvene in this thread 30m after completion for a quick retro and next steps.
